question.text: If adequate balances do not exist in the demat account when a delivery instruction is submitted, what happens?

answer.text: The instruction waits for adequate balances until the end of the execution day
The DP borrows securities from another account
The instruction is forwarded to the next settlement cycle

explanation.text: The Logic: If adequate balances do not exist, the delivery instruction waits for adequate balances until the end of the execution day. The Trap: 'Immediately rejected' is not how the system works — the instruction is allowed to wait until end of execution day. Note: If adequate balances are still not received by the end of the execution day, the instruction fails.
